items: Removed the diagonal stripes across the forest (moonbeams are off; ?moonbeams=on brings them back)
When a tree stands in front of the witch, you now see her through a soft round window that fades in gently, not a square
Land first to talk or to put down and pick up sigils, with new poses
Talking to a creature keeps its progress for a while if you break off
Placed sigils show above the canopy from the treetops
Waves every 5 minutes by default; pick how often on this screen
A small arrow points the way to the music
Slower lasers, party motes drifting over whole areas, and party light on the treetops
Woods have groves, thickets, glades and lone trees, and areas blend into each other
G shows metre rulers and a ground grid
The witch's glow lights up a much wider pool of forest round her
